website_metadata.notes: J.P. Morgan's GIFT IFSC banking unit (jpmorgan.com/IN/en/about-us/gift-city, IFSC GIFT0CHAS01) serves offshore/onshore corporate & institutional clients with fixed income, FX, commodities and debt/capital-market solutions across specified currencies (AUD,CAD,CHF,EUR,GBP,JPY,NOK,NZD,SEK,SGD,USD). No public foreign-currency term-deposit rate card; wholesale only. The 'Securities PLC' entity is a securities dealer, not a retail deposit-taking unit.

warnings: IBU / wholesale institutional; deposits not DICGC-insured; no public retail FD rate table.
